review_report.description: Dispatcher-only optimistic review with append-only audit

steps.sql: UPDATE calliope_apps.northstar_visits v SET status=$3,review_note=$2::jsonb->>'review_note',version=version+1,last_request_id=$4::uuid WHERE v.id=$2::jsonb->>'id' AND v.version=($2::jsonb->>'version')::integer AND v.status='Submitted' AND v.current_report IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calliope_apps.northstar_staff s WHERE s.email=$1 AND s.active AND s.role='dispatcher') AND $3 IN ('Accepted','Follow-up') AND length($2::jsonb->>'review_note')<=2000 AND ($3='Accepted' OR length(trim($2::jsonb->>'review_note'))>0) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calliope_apps.northstar_reviews r WHERE r.request_id=$4::uuid) RETURNING v.id,v.version

INSERT INTO calliope_apps.northstar_reviews(request_id,visit_id,report_id,reviewed_by,outcome,note,visit_version) SELECT $4::uuid,v.id,v.current_report,$1,v.status,v.review_note,v.version FROM calliope_apps.northstar_visits v WHERE v.id=$2::jsonb->>'id' AND v.version=($2::jsonb->>'version')::integer+1 AND v.status=$3 AND v.last_request_id=$4::uuid AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM calliope_apps.northstar_staff s WHERE s.email=$1 AND s.active AND s.role='dispatcher') RETURNING visit_id,outcome,reviewed_by
